answer: In PoA, each evaluator’s trust contribution decays with an exponential half-life, so reputation requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. EigenTrust matrix factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate weight only through reliable paths; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, cannot forge credible support, and therefore cannot pass consensus, even if it wanders through a grove of aliases.
